attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Montana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Montana Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.mt_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.mt_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mt_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.mt_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.mt_tax_liability xdef "Montana filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Montana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Montana starts with federal taxable income and applies state modifications.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Montana Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mt_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mt_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Montana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.mt_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mt_state_subtractions xdef "Montana adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Montana corporate income tax. Applies Montana flat rate (6.75% standard, 7.0% water's edge election) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Montana Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mt_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mt_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.mt_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Montana corporate tax (standard rate 6.75%); Apply Montana 6.75% flat rate
Calculate Montana corporate tax (water's edge rate 7.0%); Apply Montana 7.0% water's edge rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
